Rodrigo Gomez-Fell facilitated a discussion on investing in the next generation of Antarctic
expertise, and presented a [poster](../publications.qmd#ref-gomezfell2026seasonopening), at
Christchurch's Antarctic Season Opening (21 September 2026), looking ahead to the Fifth
International Polar Year (2032–33). The event is listed on the
[Teaching](../teaching.qmd#season-opening-2026) page.
